out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: The dumpster lids were not closed, as required. The waste company is not closing the dumpster lids after emptying it and placing the dumpster right up against the loading dock which traps the lid between the dumpster and the dock making it unclose-able.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. Please work with the company emptying the dumpster to get them to close the lids after emptying or to not place the dumpster so close to the dock. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the screen on the back screen door is damaged.
violations.corrective_action: Please have the screen repaired as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.
